name: space-avatar
title: Space Avatar
description: A space's tile — its icon or first initial on its hue, a corner lock when private, the lock itself for a personal space — plus SpaceOption, the space row for pickers and menus.

meta.whenToUse: Any place a space is drawn or listed: the sidebar, a space picker, a Move to… menu, a share dialog's general access row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person or team (PersonAvatar), or a record image (Thumbnail).
